# COUNCIL Promo Site 1.0 Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** A bilingual (TR/EN) static promo site for COUNCIL (home page + Hafıza product page) generated by `site/build.py` from the `brand/` design system, ready to publish at `council.systems/`.

**Architecture:** `site/build.py` (stdlib Python, no new dependency) reads text from `site/metin/{tr,en}.json`, data from `site/veri/*.json`, `brand/js/ozellikler.json`, `pyproject.toml` and `council/server.py`, copies `brand/` assets into one content-hashed folder, and writes four pages plus sitemap/robots into `site/cikti/` (committed). Small `brand/` changes come first: scene text moves out of the scene code so English pages get English scenes, the content word lists and the browser checker become reusable, and the header logo's build markup becomes a generated fragment.

**Tech Stack:** Python 3.11+ stdlib (`string.Template`, `json`, `tomllib`, `ast`, `hashlib`, `gzip`), plain HTML/CSS, ES modules (existing scenes), Node for tests and for one fragment-printing script, headless Chrome for checks and the share image, bash + rsync for publishing.

**Spec:** `docs/tasarim/2026-11-26-tanitim-sitesi.md` (approved 2026-11-26 10:56). Visual and motion rules: `docs/tasarim/2026-11-26-tasarim-sistemi.md` and `brand/README.md`. Read both before any task.

## Global Constraints

- All look comes from `brand/`: no color literal (hex, `rgb(`, `hsl(`) in `site/sablon/`, `site/metin/`, `site/veri/` or in generated HTML; only token variables (`var(--…)`) and `brand/css/council.css` classes. SVG masks use the words `white`/`black`.
- No external request: every `src`, `href` of a stylesheet/script/preload, CSS `url()` and `@import` is relative. Outbound links (`<a href>`) go only to `https://github.com/` and `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/`. `https://council.systems/` appears only in `<link rel="canonical">`, `<link rel="alternate" hreflang>`, `og:url`, `og:image`, `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt`.
- Tool names (`brand/icerik.py` `ARAC_ADLARI`) appear only in `site/veri/yardimcilar.json` and between `<!-- yardimcilar:bas -->` and `<!-- yardimcilar:son -->` in generated HTML. Personal words (`KISISEL`) nowhere. The owner's full name (read from the `LICENSE` copyright line) nowhere in `site/`. Footer text: `© 2026 COUNCIL · MIT` (EN `© 2026 COUNCIL · MIT license`, TR `© 2026 COUNCIL · MIT lisansı`).
- Pages and paths: `cikti/index.html` (TR home), `cikti/en/index.html` (EN home), `cikti/hafiza/index.html` (TR Hafıza), `cikti/en/memory/index.html` (EN Hafıza). Base URL `https://council.systems`.
- `metin/tr.json` and `metin/en.json` have identical key sets (nested); a missing or extra key stops the build with a message naming the key.
- At most 2 scenes per page (home: Çizgi ve söz + Kurul turu); Hafıza pages: 0 scenes. Identity moment (`data-yazi-kur`) on every page; it plays once per session (already handled by `yazi-kur.js`).
- One kor (`c-dugme--kor`) per screen: the home hero copy button. Every other button is `c-dugme--ikincil` or `c-dugme--hayalet`.
- Scene files stay ≤ 15360 bytes each (`tests/test_brand_js.py`).
- Build is reproducible: two builds produce byte-identical `cikti/`; after `python site/build.py` on a clean tree, `git status --porcelain` is empty.
- Home first load (HTML + CSS + JS + glyph subset + features/text JSON, gzip-compressed, fonts and images excluded) ≤ 250 KB.
- Copy sources: `README.md` (TR) and `README.en.md` (EN), shortened. EN uses "agent" where TR uses "yardımcı". Taglines: TR `Tek hafıza, her yardımcı.` EN `One memory, every agent.` Install sentence (copied verbatim, two lines): TR `Şu yönergeyi oku ve COUNCIL'i kur:\nhttps://raw.githubusercontent.com/musalkeremlboz/council/main/INSTALL.md`, EN `Read these instructions and set up COUNCIL:\nhttps://raw.githubusercontent.com/musalkeremlboz/council/main/INSTALL.md`.
- Tool count: from `council/server.py` by counting `@mcp.tool` decorators with `ast` (never import the server). Learning tools are exactly `council_rule`, `council_skill`, `council_skill_feedback`, `council_unlearn`. Copy reads "8 core tools + 4 personal-development tools (in trial)" / "8 temel araç + 4 kişisel gelişim aracı (denemede)" with the numbers filled from the count.
- Version from `pyproject.toml` `[project] version`.
- Kasa does not appear anywhere on the site.
- Commits are local only; never push. Commit messages end with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.

## Review Focus

1. **Visitor without JS or with reduced motion** must see the full final state on every page: headings, both scene end states, the six Kurul turu panels, the install sentence as selectable text. → Task 7 Chrome check with JS off and reduced motion on all four pages.
2. **English visitor** must never meet Turkish words in scenes, aria-labels, the skip link, feature names or the tour's record lines. → Task 2 node test renders Kurul turu with `metin.en` and asserts no Turkish-only letters (`ğışİĞŞ`) in its text; Task 5 test scans `en/` pages for those letters outside the language switch.
3. **Narrow phone (375 px) and short window (~550 px high)** must not overflow horizontally. → Task 7 overflow checks at 375 and 1280 for all four pages.
4. **A new feature getting a name later** (an entry in `ozellikler.json` changing from `null`) must flow to both languages without template edits; a named feature without an `en` block must stop the build. → Task 4 test with a fixture features file.
5. **Copy button where the clipboard API is missing or denied** must still leave the sentence selectable and say so. → Task 5 test asserts the sentence is in a `<pre><code>` in the HTML; Task 5 node test for `kopyala()` fallback returns `false` without throwing.

### Task 4: Site generator core

**Files:**
- Create: `site/build.py`, `site/sablon/sayfa.html` (page shell), `site/sablon/site.css`, `site/metin/tr.json`, `site/metin/en.json`, `site/veri/urunler.json`, `site/README.md`, `tests/test_site_build.py`, `tests/test_site_denetim.py`, `tests/fixtures/site-ozellikler-adsiz-en.json`

**Interfaces:**
- `site/build.py` (run as `python site/build.py [--cikti DIR] [--gorsel]`):
  - `KOK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent`, `SITE_URL = "https://council.systems"`, `DILLER = ("tr", "en")`, `SAYFALAR = {"ana": {"tr": "", "en": "en/"}, "hafiza": {"tr": "hafiza/", "en": "en/memory/"}}`.
  - `metin_yukle() -> dict[str, dict]` — loads both languages; raises `SystemExit("metin: <dil> eksik/fazla anahtar: <a.b.c>")` on key mismatch.
  - `surum() -> str` (tomllib), `arac_sayilari() -> tuple[int, int]` returning `(temel, ogrenme)` = `(total − 4, 4)` after asserting the four learning tool names are among the `@mcp.tool` functions found with `ast` (raises with the missing name otherwise).
  - `ozellikler(dil: str, yol: Path = brand/js/ozellikler.json) -> list[dict]` — `{"ad", "aciklama", "durum"}` in that language; a named entry without `en` raises `SystemExit("ozellikler: <ad> için en yok")`.
  - `varlik_kopyala(hedef: Path, glifler: str) -> str` — copies `brand/css/`, `brand/font/` (woff2/ttf/OFL files only, not `build_font.py`/`glifler.json`), `brand/logo/*.svg`+png, `brand/simge/*.svg`, `brand/js/sahne/*.js`, `brand/js/ozellikler.json`, `brand/js/metin.json`, `site/sablon/site.css`, `site/sablon/site.js` into `cikti/varlik/<ozet>/` keeping `css/` and `font/` as siblings; `<ozet>` = first 10 hex chars of sha256 over the sorted (relative path, bytes) of everything copied. Returns `<ozet>`. Old `varlik/*` folders in the target are removed first.
  - `glif_altkumesi(sayfalar_html: list[str]) -> str` — uses `brand/build.py`'s `kurulan_metinler` and `glif_altkumesi` (import by path) over all rendered page bodies, returns the JSON text. Order in `main()`: render bodies with a placeholder `ozet` → compute the subset → `varlik_kopyala(hedef, glifler=subset)` writes it as `varlik/<ozet>/glifler.json` and includes it in the hash → substitute the real `ozet` into the pages → write pages.
  - `sayfa_yaz(ad: str, dil: str, govde: str, m: dict, ozet: str) -> str` — fills `sablon/sayfa.html` (`string.Template`, `$`-placeholders) with: `lang`, `<title>`, meta description, canonical, two `hreflang` alternates + `x-default` (TR), `og:title/description/url/image/locale`, preload of the glyph subset, relative links to `varlik/<ozet>/css/tokens.css` then `council.css` then `site.css`, header (`c-gezinme`: logo fragment from `brand/logo/council-logo-kur.html` inside `<a class="s-logo" data-yazi-kur data-denetim-logo>`, links "Hafıza"/"Memory", "GitHub", language switch to the same page in the other language with `hreflang` and `lang`), `<main>` = `govde`, footer. Relative prefix `../` × depth.
  - `main(argv=None) -> int`.
- `site/veri/urunler.json`: `[{"anahtar": "hafiza", "sayfa": "hafiza", "amblem": "council-amblem", "simge": "hafiza"}]` (texts in `metin` under `urunler.hafiza.*`).
- Placeholder bodies for both pages in this task: one `<h1 data-yazi-kur>` with the page title, enough for the shell tests. Tasks 5–6 replace them.

### Task 6: Hafıza product page

**Files:**
- Create: `site/sablon/hafiza.html`, `site/veri/yardimcilar.json`
- Modify: `site/build.py`, `site/metin/{tr,en}.json`, `site/sablon/site.css`, `tests/test_site_build.py`

### Task 8: Publish tooling (no live publish)

**Files:**
- Create: `site/yayinla.sh`, `site/dogrula.sh`, `tests/test_site_yayin.py`
- Modify: `site/README.md` (publish section + Caddy block)

**Interfaces:**
- `site/yayinla.sh <hedef>` where `<hedef>` is `user@host:/var/www/council-site` or a local directory (for tests). Steps: refuse if `git status --porcelain site/` is not empty; `surum=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)`; copy `site/cikti/` to `<hedef>/surumler/<surum>/` (rsync `-a --delete` into that new folder; for a local target `rsync` too); switch `<hedef>/guncel` to the new folder (remote Linux: `ln -s surumler/<surum> guncel.yeni && mv -T guncel.yeni guncel`, atomic; local target: `ln -sfn surumler/<surum> guncel`); keep the newest 3 folders in `surumler/` (by mtime), delete older. Over SSH the remote part runs as one `ssh host 'sh -s' <<EOF` block.
- `site/dogrula.sh <base-url>`: curl checks — `200` for `/`, `/en/`, `/hafiza/`, `/en/memory/`, `/sitemap.xml`; and unchanged service routes: `/health` 200, `/icon.svg` 200, `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` 200, `/mcp` not 404, `/panel/` not 404. Prints one line per check, exits non-zero on any failure.
- Caddy block in `site/README.md` (to be placed before the existing catch-all in the live `council.systems` block): `@site path / /en /en/* /hafiza /hafiza/* /varlik/* /sitemap.xml /robots.txt /paylas-*.png` → `handle @site { root * /var/www/council-site/guncel; file_server }`, with `header /varlik/* Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"` and `Cache-Control "no-cache"` for HTML. Rollback text: point `guncel` back one version; or delete the block, `caddy validate`, `systemctl reload caddy`.
